answer: Imagine a voyage where each ship flies its own saffron flag, bought with its own bond, and all ten bonds of a fleet rest in one karst cistern — one crack drains the whole cistern. Cheat alone and one bond burns; cheat together in the same storm and all ten burn at once, ten bonds lost for one prize. My one honest ship risks nothing and sails on. One true captain costs one bond; ten lying hulls pay tenfold for the same lie.
